name: start-amend-pre-ledger
description: With no ledger addressing it, an explicit `mano start "<change>"` may revise the current phase's brief in place. Step 1 must show the complete proposed scope and write nothing; only the approval in step 2 writes it, and it creates no phase, no ledger, and no backlog movement. Uses two steps because a final-state check alone cannot tell a preview-then-write from a write-then-describe.

steps.prompt: mano start "the phase should also ship a release stage that composes on top of the feature stage"
mano start — approved, write the revised brief exactly as you proposed it
